channel.title: Cockroach Labs incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Cockroach Labs's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Cloud Latency, Delays, Connection Issues [resolved]
item.description:
Google impacts are now reported as fully resolved. Internal teams have confirmed this report. All services are restored.
Should you need further help, please reach out and file a ticket with Support.

item.title: Cluster connectivity and execution issues [resolved]
item.description: Following an extended period of monitoring, the team has confirmed that the cluster remains healthy and stable.

item.title: Cluster Creation Failure [resolved]
item.description: The cluster creation issue has been restored. Issue is resolved.

item.title: Unable to accept invites [resolved]
item.description: Fix deployment is complete, tested and verified.

item.title: Degraded performance in one AWS us-east-1 availability zone [resolved]
item.description: All CockroachDB clusters in the affected AWS availability zone have been restored to a fully operational state. We will continue to monitor the upstream incident from AWS, but do not expect any impact to CockroachDB clusters.

item.title: Cloud Console Social Login Auth Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Social login for Microsoft accounts is now available. Please reach out to support if you continue to experience issues.

item.title: Cluster unavailability and degraded cluster operations in AWS me-central... [resolved]
item.description:
Beginning March 1, 2026, a power outage caused by physical damage to AWS infrastructure affected multiple Availability Zones in the AWS me-central-1 (UAE) region, resulting in the unavailability of CockroachDB Cloud clusters in that region. A single Availability Zone in me-south-1 was also impacted, causing degraded performance for clusters in that region.
While AWS has not yet fully restored power to all affected Availability Zones, Cockroach Labs has directly engaged all customers impacted by this incident, providing resolution guidance and hands-on remediation assistance, including cross-region data restoration where applicable.

item.title: Connectivity issues to Standard and Basic clusters on AWS [resolved]
item.description: Standard and Basic clusters continue to function normally.

item.title: Advanced cluster creation on AWS taking longer than expected [resolved]
item.description: We have deployed and verified a fix. Advanced clusters should now create within normal time frames.

item.title: Standard and Basic cluster creation on AWS delayed [resolved]
item.description: All cluster operations are working normally.

item.title: Advanced Cluster Creation Delayed [resolved]
item.description: Cluster creation is operating normally, and all delayed clusters have finished creation.

item.title: AWS us-east-1 outage impacting cluster operations and backups [resolved]
item.description: The earlier AWS outage in the us-east-1 region has been fully resolved. All CockroachDB Cloud operations, including cluster creation, scaling, and backups, are functioning normally again. We’ve verified recovery across affected systems and customer clusters, and normal operations have resumed.

item.title: Google Kubernetes incident impacting cluster operations in GCP. [resolved]
item.description: Google has reported the issue has been resolved and we've verified cluster operations are functional.
